avis.texte: This toner is PHENOMENAL. I love that it is unscented and the hydration is next level. This needs to be restocked asap. Its been out of stock for a while.

Sadly, after 4 days I developed many red spots on my t-zone which is my most sensitive area. Only new product and stopping use stopped the spots. I've strugged with acne for 10+ years now. After years of searching for the right products i found this one! Ive been using it for around a year now and just finished the bottle. Highly recommend
Refreshing and moisturizing on the skin without feeling sticky or thick layered. Gotta try it if you haven't yet!

I received a free 30ml bottle of this as a gift with purchase. I have sensitive skin and had no issues while using this. It's gentle and leaves skin feeling clean but not dry. I felt my skin looked clearer after just the few weeks this bottle lasted. I would definitely recommend this product and may purchase it as well.
I definitely recommend this product! It feels very moisture on my skin and super easy to apply. You don't need a pad at all! It doesn't feel sticky and absorbs easily.

Live in a desert and was hoping it would help improve dryness and help absorb products based on other reviews. Saw zero change. Good - dispenses easily and lasts quite a while. Goes on smooth. Gentle and non irritating Bad - didnt help in any way. Wanted to love it but am struggling to understand its purpose. avis.titre: Fantastic toner for dry climates; mature skin
avis.texte: This is my favorite toner by far. It contisne no unnecessary phototoxic fragrance or essential oils and has all good for skin ingredients. It feels cushiony going onc provides a nice moisture boost to one's regimen, is excellent for mature, dry skin and drier climates. Those with oily skin wikl appreciate that it's not greasy and soaks right in. To get the maximum effect of the cushiony feeling, I prefer to apply a nickel or quarter size amount directly with my hands to my face, no cotton pad.

I am 42 with dry skin and fine lines, but generally problem free skin. I was looking for a toner to help restore moisture and elasticity and this one did the trick. I like that this toner is unscented, absorbs easily and is very moisturizing. It is not thick or sticky, but also not watery, so I can apply with my fingers. No feeling of stripping skin, but also feels very clean.
this has restored my skin's elasticity, cleared my very subborn dry patches, and soothed my irritated dry skin. absolutely reccomend for those with dry skin
this has restored my skin's elasticity, cleared my very subborn dry patches, and soothed my irritated dry skin. absolutely reccomend for those with dry skin

i liked it but it wasn't anything exceptional. it didn't improve nor worsen my skin. i like that it's unscented and not super watery. i won't be repurchasing, but if you have normal/dry skin and aren't acne prone then this would be a good basic toner for you.
If youre starting fine lines around your face due to skin dehydration, especially for dry skinned people, this is perfect for reducing those lines
Literally the best toner I've ever used. it isnt too watery and isn't too thick. it doesn't have a scent which I love! The only toner I will ever use!
brings my skin back to life. when i run out, ive tried others but always come back to this one. helps other products absorb better and traps moisture in my skin. love love love!

This has been an instant classic in my skincare routine. I have incredibly inflamed, acne-prone skin that is easily congested yet easy dry. This toner really helped layer on hydration without clogging pores, and maintain a healthy skin barrier. Giant bottle, I drop right in my hands and pat into my face right after cleansing.

Love this toner for when my skin is going through a hard time. If my skin hurts when being touched or it feels like it is burning, I stop using all my skincare products except for a few that are very simple but very hydrating and repairing. This product is very soothing and hydrating. I recommend using multiple layers because my dry and dehydrated skin soaks this toner up. Despite my extensive skincare collection, I always have an uncented supple toner on hand for use.

Put a ring on it, she's the one. Switching brands immediately, not passing go or collecting $200. This is one of those toners that's a teeny tiny touch on the thicker side, so sometimes I'll put something waterlike under it if I'm feeling extra. Absorbs nicely.
I love love love this toner! I have dry + sensitive skin and its hard to find toners that don't burn. This one is hydrating, gentle, and just all around perfect. Have purchased it twice so far.
Love it. The viscosity of the product reallt give moisture to the skin and calming

There's no telling how many bottles of this I have used over the past 4 or so years. I love that the texture is a little thicker than water. I use multiple layers, depending how thirsty my skin feels. My skin loves it
Great toner! Been using daily for several years. Gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I heard so many great things about this
avis.texte: I heard so many great things about this toner, so I decided to try it out. It is great to prep dry sensitive skin before your skincare Very hydrating and most importantly no frangrance.!

avis.titre: I really love the wet hydrated feel of this thicker like ton
avis.texte: I really love the wet hydrated feel of this thicker like toner! This feels super smooth and soft on my skin. This toner reminds me sort of like my our hyaluronic acid serums (texture wise) and they feel super similar on the face also….. :) I use 2x daily. Use this as your last toner, but before putting on your serums and then top of it all off with a nice, thick but non-scented cream! You'll love the way your face feels. Enjoy…. 💯💛
One of my favorite toners, been using for four years and have gone through more bottles than I can count.
really great, after a cleanser it makes my skin feel nice and tight, great addition to my routine

avis.titre: This is a great toner that doesn't cause any irritation
avis.texte: The unscented supple preparation toner is a lighter version of the regular toner. This is a great toner that doesn't cause any irritation but I prefer the regular toner because I find it to be a bit more hydrating than the unscented version. But if your skin doesn't react well to essential oils, the unscented version is a better option.

avis.titre: The toner absorbs instantly, leaving no stickiness or heavin
avis.texte: The toner absorbs instantly, leaving no stickiness or heaviness. The skin becomes incredibly soft to the touch, feeling both hydrated and soothed at the same time. After use, the skin looks plump, healthy, and moisturized, with the effect lasting throughout the day.
This is my favorite toner since 2021! I love it so much cause it's so mild and perfect for my oily skin.

avis.titre: Perfect for those with allergies to essential oils or scents
avis.texte: It's perfect for those with allergies to essential oils or scents and is recommended for sensitive skin. It has a light texture, but with a little more consistency than water and absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving a sticky or oily feeling. I love it!, I used one already and this is my second one. My skin always feels calm and hydrated with it.

avis.titre: calms my sensitive and reactive skin within minutes!!
avis.texte: I'm 45 and my skin is changing. It has become sensitive and reactive to certain products; especially, sunscreens. My irritated face gets red and feels extremely spicy. Klair's calmed my face within minutes -I was amazed. I purchased two more during 21 days of beauty.

I have tried SO many toners and so many I feel like I can't even notice I put on. This one is so thick its almost like a serum and has become a go to for reparing my skin barrier. Love that it is unscented as well so it never irritates my skin.

I wanted a new toner after using Bliss for years. I tried this toner based on reviews and I was not disappointed. It took my skin about two weeks to become accustomed to it. My skin is now much clearer and im getting compliments from strangers.

I have sensitive skin with adult acne that I had finally gotten under control for the better part of a year. I tried this because of the great reviews, and while it does feel really nice, I started breaking out immediately. Thought it was a fluke and continued to use it for a couple of weeks, but every day was something new multiple spots on my face. Will not buy again.
Such a no brainer. I use a few drops on a damp face, let it set and then do my moisturizer. Would never go without. Keeps skin hydrated and plump
Great for oily skin. Not too heavy and you only need a couple drops. If you live in a hot climate put this in fridge! It feels amazing afterwards.
I used this toner for a while and switched to another one. recently got a sample again and holy cow I must not have realized how much the other toner was lacking. I'll never make this mistake again!
Toner is great for PM. Very moisturizing. Adds too much shine for day wear.
Ive bought more bottles of this than i can count. 1st step in my morning and night routine. Perfect beginning to my routine. Hydrating, soothing, love and will always continue to buy!

I never knew I needed this until i tried it. I've tried a couple toners and I've never had a toner that helped repair my skin barrier better. my skin and makeup is noticably smoother now. withing the first couple uses I noticed a difference. I definitely Recommend

I have acne-prone skin that is combo/dry (depending on the season). I have large pores and some light acne scarring and some redness in my cheeks/nose. I didn't notice any positive or negative differences with this toner. There was no change in my skin's appearance. It didn't minimize my pores, prevent blackheads, or add much moisture. I went back to using my previous toner (Grown Alchemist) because it works wonders for my skin.

I wanted to include a toner in my routine again and chose this because of all the positive reviews. First impression was that it felt nice on my skin. Didn't feel sticky and all my other skincare items absorbed nicely into it. Unfortunately, it left my face in breakouts and bumps within a few days. I took it out of my routine and tried again a couple months later, and it did the same thing. It's been a couple weeks since I stopped using it again and my face is clearing up. I didn't use any other new products or during my trials, so I know it was this toner.

I've tried countless toners in the past, starting with plain witch hazel and working my way through literal dozens of toners. However, this is the FIRST TONER EVER that didn't break me out, dry my skin out, clog my pores, irritate my skin, or exacerbate my pores/oiliness. In fact, my skin as calmed so much from using this toner that I no longer struggle with excess oil or dry/rough patches. Definitely leaves skin supple and balanced!

This toner is truly one of a kind. It's healthy for all skin types, great that it's unscented (able to be used on anyone). It's in the name, it leaves your skin feeling supple and ready to take on any day. I will definitely continue to use it.

I stopped using toners as ones I'd tried in the past either caused irritation or gave me no benefit so I saw them as an unnecessary step in my skincare regimen. Then I received a free sample of this and wow! It's different to any toner I've used in the past, it is thick but not oily or greasy. It soaks in straight away and hydrates my skin leaving it really soft. I've since bought a bottle and will keep buying so long as they don't change the formula.

I received this as a sample and it's excellent for extremely sensitive skin!! It's moisturizing and very calming and hasn't caused any problems. It's not greasy or oily, it's like a very light serum, it's excellent!

Klairs unscented toner - this is a light weight toner that hydrates and brightens the skin. Made with butylene and licorice extract. I simply sprinkle a couple of drops onto my finger tips and press into the skin. My skin drinks it up. Great hydration. Gifted by klairs.

SERIOUSLY. My skin had been feeling like sandpaper because I had completely ruined my skin barrier. So I browsed and browsed and found this toner. It has a thicker formula so its not runny, fragrance/dye free, and can be used with your hands. It makes my skin feel supple and not tight anymore. It is such a great toner to put into your routine.

Loved it! Highly reviewed and recommended for a reason. It's very moisturizing and one of my first steps as someone with super dry and sensitive skin. I also love that it's unscented so no sensitivity. Complimentary from Dear,Klairs

Just purchased my second bottle of this. I have sensitive skin and have struggled with acne in the past, I attribute this product to helping my skin stay clear and healthy! It is very gentle and moisturizing.
This is the best toner I've tried. I've tried SK II, La Mer Clinique ect. I use it after cleansing and before serum. I feel it makes my skin softer and helps everything else absorb better.

I keep my skin healthy using a dedicated skincare ritual and I'm so happy to add this toner to my list. The toner is divine and so gentle. It does a great job balancing the skin's ph while also hydrating ahead of any serums. It's decent size and can last a long time. I was gifted this product for testing purposes. Gifted by Dear, Klairs.

I've been using the supple preparation unscented toner for about 2 weeks, and your girl is HOOKED. I have very oily skin and I've found this to help so much with controlling the oiliness of my skin through the day. I also love that it doesn't strip my skin of moisture like I encounter with other toners in the past. This toner was gifted by Dear, Klairs but I'll 100% be purchasing when this bottle and checking out the rest of their line.

I feel like the toners I have used in the past have made my skin feel a little stripped. I wanted something that would be more moisturizing so I gave this product to try. I've been really happy with how deeply hydrating it is! My face feels great after using it! You can get it at ulta.com. Gifted by Dear, Klairs

i've been using this for a few weeks now and i can't tell if it's benefitting my skin. i don't notice a huge difference other than my skin feeling clean when i use it. it doesn't cause me any irritation either. gifted by dear klaris

Gifted by Dear, Klair's in exchange for my honest review. Absolutely love this toner, so hydrating, perfect for my combination, sensitive skin. I love that it's an unscented toner. Highly recommend it!

Complimentary from Dear, Klairs. I love this so much! It's honestly been such a great addition to my skincare. It has been hydrating my skin so well and leaving it so plump. I love that it's unscented so there's no added worry about break outs. I also really love the consistency of it, it has a bit of a thicker toner feel to it.

i received this product for free complimentary from Dear, Klairs. I've been using this toner for a few weeks now and have been loving it. i love applying before lactic acid and retinols to add more moisture to my skin. It literally has no scent and doesn't pile under my other products.

This product was gifted by Klairs. I used the original years ago in 2016 or 2017 and loved it so I was obviously excited to try the unscented version! It's so lovely and leaves my skin feeling so supple and soft.

Absolutely a must have for hydration. I really need to stock up for this upcoming winter. I love this somewhat thicker texture, and no smell at all. I only use my hands to apply, no cotton pads and so on. Gifted by Klairs

Absolutely amazing toner, pure hydration in a bottle! It absorbs so quickly and immediately gives beautiful glowing results on the skin. I like to use it in the morning and evening before my moisturizer, or just by itself. I love that it fragrance free! Gifted by Klairs

I love this product because it has no fragrance or any kind of scent that will irritate my sensitive skin. This line in general tends to have really great ingredients and reliable skin care for people with sensitive skin such as me. Gifted by Dear, Klairs

This unscented toner works very well for my dry skin, I use it every day in my morning face routine. It provides hydration, preparing it to receive other products such as serum and moisturizer. Do not have any scent which is more beneficial for the skin, especially for people who have sensitive skin. My skins health looks better over all. Gifted by Dear Klairs.

This is such a nice toner to have in my routine. It refreshes the skin and doesn't have a fragrance which I love. I've been using it every morning and I find that it helps to maintain a moist base and seems to help calm my acne. This toner was gifted by dearklairs for my honest review.

I received this complimentary from Dear Klairs. I was pleasantly surprised at the consistency of this! Not too watery, more of a denser molecule feeling. This left my skin feeling completely hydrated (thank you hyaluronic acid) Huge plus- it's unscented! I try to avoid scents when it comes to skincare, but I appreciate this as a simple layer, and not too complicated.

Gifted by Dears, klairs. This toner is amazing. It helps with my dryness and my redness. It's non-irritating, unscented. It's a good size product. I would definitely buy when i run out and recommend it to a friend.

Klairs gifted me the unscented toner. This is a great product because it works well to neutralize the ph of the skin. It's very gentle and layers well with my other facial products. This really helps keep my skin looking it's best.

This is one of my all-time favorites! I have been using this for a long time. It is perfect for my dry skin. It provides the long-lasting hydration I need and it is super calming and soothing on the skin. My skin is supple and soft! Love it! *Complimentary from Dearklairs

I've heard so much about this toner and was really excited to try. After two weeks my skin visibly improved. It's more hydrated, smooth and I love that this toner doesn't have essential oils which works for my sensitive skin. It was gifted to me by dearklairs.

This toner has made my skin noticeably soft, and I believe it's helping to keep my skin clear. I'm loving it and totally recommend it. Gifted by dearklairs.

I have pretty sensitive skin so I prefer unscented skincare and this was perfect. I heard so many good things so I was excited to try this, gifted by Klairs. The texture is gel like but very thin. It's also hydrating!

This toner is amazing. I don't think you understand the wonders that this product does for my face!!! my skin is so hydrated and feels so fresh as soon as I put it on, I highly recommend this product that was gifted by Dear, Klairs

I received this Supple Preparation Unscented Facial Toner complimentary from Klairs and was immediately impressed from the first use. This toner's texture is unlike any I've tried before. It leaves my skin looking and feeling so hydrated and moisturized. I absolutely love it!

avis.titre: Perfect for dry or sensitive skin!

It makes my skin feel plump and hydrated, like a splash of water that actually stays on your skin all day. And the cherry on top is that it doesn't have fragrance, so it's suited for sensitive girlies! gifted by dearklairs

Really a fan of how easy this is to use as well as the deep hydration it gave my face! I have very sensitive and very dry skin, and the fact that it's in scented helps a lot and it wasn't irritating at all! I love the Klairs unscented toner because it removes my oils and leaves my face hydrated. I like that it is oil free. I noticed a reduction in my whiteheads. I like the main ingredient is Hyaluronic Acid to provide moisture and hydration. Complimentary from Dear, Klairs

This toner has been nice so far since using. My skins health looks better over all. I do love that this wasn't scented! That was a huge bonus for me!!! Really excited to see how it continues to work for me.

I received this product complimentary from Dear klairs in exchange for my honest review. This is a moisturizing toner. I have been using this for a few weeks now and my skin feels more dewy and soft my skin never had a breakout with this either and I can really see a difference.

This is great for hydrating and soothing my skin!

When I don't use this toner, I can feel the difference because my skin just feels less hydrated. Highly recommend.

My skin appears to be more plump afterward. I have oily, combination skin, so I prefer to only use this at night. During the day it may feel a bit too much moisturization. Overall I enjoy it.

I absolutely adore Klairs' toner! I first discovered this gem a few years ago, and it continues to impress me just as much today. Its luxuriously thick texture feels like a refreshing sip of hydration for your skin. What sets it apart for me is its gentle, unscented formula, which means no overwhelming fragrances or irritations to contend with. This toner embodies simplicity, effectiveness, and affordability, making it a perfect choice. My dehydrated, oily skin gives it a wholehearted approval!gifted by dearklairs.

an essential oil-free toner. It is formulated with a base of various bonatical extracts to balance the skin's pH level and provide full nourishment to the skin. I like it is good for sensitive skin as well.

I don't have any cons, other than I wish it was in a bigger bottle. The formula itself is amazing and I usually use this on days I need extra hydration my routine. I'll layer this between my serums for extra hydration. I sincerely love this toner and highly recommend anyone to try especially if you have dehydrated skin. Gifted by Klairs.

Gifted by Klarins. I love this Korean brand and this is such a great toner. I have acne-prone skin so it's important for me that a toner removed excess dirt in sebum. In addition, this toner calms irritation, has a light texture and absorbs so nicely into the skin.

Gifted by Klairs. A great basic toner for everyday use or during actives. The toner is unscented and does not contain any essential oil so it is great for sensitive skin to use. The texture is slightly viscous. It is hydrating and able to layer.

I've been loving this toner so much. It feels so refreshing on the skin and it absorbs fast without leaving my skin feeling oily. I love that it has hyaluronic acid and many great ingredients for your skin. My skin looks so hydrated and healthy. Complimentary from Dear, Klairs.

Gifted by Klairs. A great basic toner for everyday use or during actives. The toner is unscented and does not contain any essential oil so it is great for sensitive skin to use. The texture is slightly viscous. It is hydrating and able to layer.

Other than that this is a perfect first time toner, especially for dehydration in the skin. Gifted by Dear, Klairs.

I've used the original supple preparation toner and I had no issues even though I'm sensitive but there were times I wish it was less scented and this is the answer to that. This gives instant hydration and I love using this on those over the top skincare days. I usually add this toner in between my serums for added hydration. I highly recommend anyone to try this as a great way to retain moisture balance in your skins health. Gifted by Dear Klairs.

Such a nice toner! I saw the texture and thought it would be sticky and slimy but not at all! It feels emollient when I pour it on my hands and feels very refreshing and lightweight. It absorbs fast on my skin and helps my skin getting plumped and hydrated immediately. Really love the texture of this one! It's not sticky at all and my skin feels ready! Gifted by Dear, Klairs

Really loves How It's feel on my face! Using It right after clenser! Love How hydrated my skin is after! Soft and silky! Amazing that is available on Ulta now! My favorite store for beauty shopping!!! Nice packaging, unisex , so men's can use it too

avis.titre: My ride or die for several years
avis.texte: If you have sensitive reactive skin, however, you do need a deep hydration. This is definitely the product for you. I have been using this product for a couple of years and it's definitely my ride or die toner. My complexion is acne, prone and eczema prone. Therefore, I have a hard time finding products that do not irritate my skin. using this unscented toner, right after I wash my face, it's regulates the pH on my skin. I have noticed skin is less try and reactive, and it also helps enhancing the resilience of my skin. Excellent product. Complimentary from dear Klairs

avis.titre: I would buy this product my self!
avis.texte: Klairs gifted me this toner, and it immediately became my favorite! It has a watery and viscous texture. It provides hydration to my skin with a lightweight feel and a non-sticky finish. I can layer it up to 2 times, and my skin still happily absorbs it. It makes my skin feel plump and amazing. Additionally, it has no fragrance, which is really great.

This toner has been so great! It feels so refreshing when I put it on my skin and I like how it has made my skin feel smoother already. I like to put it on after I was my face. It was gifted by Klairs.

I love it! It's available in ultra and I love shopping there! This toner really sink into my skin well and moisture my skin well. I like there is no smell to be disturbed with and I feel really clean after using it

I've had my eye on this toner for quite some time! It's a lightweight solution that rebalances the skin's pH and moisture levels post-cleanse. Infused with plant extracts, hyaluronic acid, and beta-glucan, it ensures the skin remains calm, hydrated, and comforted. It's suitable for normal, dry, combination, and even sensitive skin types. I've incorporated this into my routine right after cleansing, and it sinks into the skin swiftly without leaving much stickiness behind. While it layers beautifully for that coveted glass-skin effect, it might not be the most hydrating on its own but blends seamlessly with other skincare essentials. Truly, it's formulated with gentleness in mind!

This has the consistency of a light serum more than a toner. I use it before applying other skin care if I feel like my skin is dry. I think it'll be nice in the winter. It doesn't have a fragrance which I also like the only thing I would change about it is that the bottle is kind of messy to use, it would have been nicer as a pump or a dropper bottle. Gifted by dear klairs

I received this product complimentary from dearklairs. This toner has a thicker texture compared to other toners. However, I wouldn't use it in the summer when my skin leans towards the oilier side because it can feel heavy on the skin. So far my sensitive skin doesn't react badly to this product and I can see myself using it more regularly in the winter months.

Completely unscented which I love! It's perfect for my very sensitive skin, the ingredient list is fantastic. My skin is fresh and moisturized after each time I use it. I always use it before my serum and moisturizer. I received it complimentary from Dear, Klairs and I'd definitely recommend it.

Definitely a good quality toner—hydrates my sensitive skin and I can feel how my skin absorbs it when I apply it. I'm def going to continue using this product.

Wow! This is a great toner to have in your skincare routine! It's great at prepping the skin for the next steps but I also love how it moisturizes and of course the fact that this is unscented is awesome! Gifted by Dear, Klairs

I received this unscented toner complimentary from Dear, Klairs. This toner is really good for combination and sensitive skin types. Very gentle on my skin. I'm using it morning and evening every day and no irritation on my skin. My skin loves it

I was happy to have gotten it complimentary from Klairs.

I decided to try an unscented toner because as someone who loves scents and all, I'm not crazy about having my face toner infused with scents for now. So right now, I'm trying this toner gifted by Dear Klairs

avis.titre: Can't believe it's not a serum!

Ok, so this is a perfect example of not overselling your product, and delivering on your claims. There is nothing fancy or earth shattering about this toner. And it doesn't claim to be. Instead it has simple and straightforward claims of balancing the ph, providing deep hydration, and prepping the skin for your serums without causing irritation. And it does that beautifully! I have dry eczema prone skin while also living in a dry desert climate, and it just drinks this stuff up! I drench my face in it every night, and it's like a powder punch of hydration to the face. And even more surprisingly, you don't need a massive amount. It has a consistency somewhere between a true liquid, and a gel type serum. Like a thick kind of water. It glides onto the skin smoothly, and takes a few moments to sink in. It doesn't just disappear immediately like a true watery toner does. This makes it exceptionally good for dry climates. The moisture isn't just sucked off into the air immediately. It lingers on the skin, allowing the hydration to really penetrate. Because it's so thin, but full of body, you only need a quarter sized amount for your face, neck, and décolletage. And with a bottle that holds more than 6 fl.oz. That's going to last you quite a while. Even if you use it morning and night. If you're oily, or even combo leaning oily, this might be too much for you. But if you're normal to dry, especially if you have sensitive/reactive skin, or you live in a very dry or arid climate, then
This toner is so hydrating I usually drench my face in this after cleansing. Then use my gua sha for about 15 min then apply my serums and moisturizers! Saw less wrinkles and keeps my face youthful!
